frame: x west along the screen (the front faces north), y up from the court's floor, z north (out of the front); metres

chord.note: the screen's chord over the end piers' outer corners: P0343 (d, by S603's 1.30 m socle), the plan 14.46 m (b)

sag.note: how far the ends come forward of the middle: P0640 and P0764 (the inner panels 0.4 m, the outer 1.4 m forward of the centre one, by their sizes; the reader)

bay_c.note: the centre bay, the widest: plate 16 169 px against 135-158 for the others; the pitch about 2.5 m on P0343

pier_w.note: each end pier, a pier and a recessed strip: plate 16 about 40 px of 794

plat_y.note: the platform above the court: five steps of about 0.14 m (P0344, P0764); the platform survives in place (S603 p.129)

socle_h.note: the socle of the trophy wall, as high as the court's slope: S603 note 17 with p.127 (a reading of two statements)

plinth_h.note: the block under each panel: P0764 32 px against the socle's 87 px

panel_h.note: the panel frames: P0764 150 px at the socle's scale (2.2 m), P0343 2.5 m

panel_w.note: the middle panel's frame: P0343, 100 px at 81 px/m

pil_top.note: the pilasters' tops under the entablature: plate 16, 50 px of entablature under the cornice; v1's 4.45 m sat 0.5 m low on P0777 and P0764

cornice.note: the cornice's top above the socle's foot: P0777 (1873, the cornice whole) and the end piers today (P0343, P0764) put it 0.5 m above v1's 5.1 m (plate 16's module 4.0 m, P0343's end pier 5.1 m)

crest_h.note: the openwork crest over the cornice, a mask cartouche on the axis: plate 16, 35-40 px

urn_h.note: the urns of fruit over the four pilasters and the pairs over the end piers: plate 16, about 80 px over the cornice

backing.note: the brick backing behind the panels (S02 pp.158-159: a brick screen holding marble panels; P0300 shows it torn): its depth assumed

plat_r.note: the round platform's radius: P0640 and P0764 (a circle about as wide as the three middle panels); the plan box 14.5 x 11.5 m holds screen and platform

plat_cz.note: the circle's middle before the screen's middle (its back rim just in front of the socle, P0640)

steps.note: five convex steps: P0344, P0764 and plate 16 (75 px on the axis)

throne_h.note: the throne from the platform to the crown of its canopy: plate 16, about 1.3 panel heights (300 px)

rail_h.note: the low balustrade round the platform with armour trophies on its posts: plate 16, about 90 px; gone today

trophy_x.note: the trophy pedestals at the platform's front corners, before the end piers: plate 16 x 826 and 1573

obel_x.note: the obelisks just beyond the end piers: plate 16 90-110 px outside the screen's ends; today they stand there on a low base (P0764)

obel_top.note: the obelisk's ball top above the court: plate 16, 150 px under the cornice; today the cut tip stands at the panels' tops (P0764)

gate_x.note: the side gates, 33.86 m apart centre to centre: the plan's skewed squares either side of the screen (b)

gate_w.note: each gate's width: plate 16, 219 px at the gates' module

gate_h.note: the gate's crest above its threshold: P0193 (Child, 1870s) draws it 1.06 times its width; plate 16's fit wants it 2.4 m higher (Q233); P0193 is Child's photograph (S70)

gate_turn.note: the flights run obliquely towards the court's middle: plate 16; v2's straight flights put their feet 3 m too far out

garden_y.note: the gardens' level above the court: the slope's drop (S603, survey)

gate_steps.note: the flight down from each gate to the court: about ten steps on plate 16

wall_top.note: the plain back wall's coping above the court: plate 16, about 150 px under the cornice

hedge_h.note: the clipped hedges between the gates and the screen: plate 16

wall_z.note: the back wall's line behind the screen; the court's sunk area ends 6.5 m south of the screen's box (XY10-M45), the wall assumed nearer
